verification_boundary: Static partial audit of selected workflow families, not a runtime registry or exhaustive list of public methods. Source anchors prove location only. Evidence paths point to tests, documentation or scoped historical reports; this checker neither runs them nor certifies installation/live qualification. Audit IDs are not callable runtime action IDs.

capabilities.title: Selected-window Observe capture
limits: Captures the selected target; valid target identity, capture availability, dimensions and frame age remain necessary.

deck_binding.detail: Capture supplies observations; it is not an executable deck card.

evidence.scope: Offline bounded-capture test source; not run by this inventory.

capabilities.next_gap: Link installed capture metrics and target-specific qualification to the same capability view.

capabilities.title: Video and process-audio recording
limits: Encoder/capture throughput and audio availability depend on the selected target and local resources; configured FPS is not delivered FPS.

deck_binding.detail: Recording is a workspace service, not a play card.

capabilities.next_gap: Keep achieved FPS, source timestamps, dropped frames and finalized outputs visible together.

capabilities.title: Opt-in synchronized game inputs
limits: User opt-in, selected game focus and allowed input scope are required; absent recorded input does not prove no player action.

deck_binding.detail: Records demonstrations; does not independently dispatch deck actions.

capabilities.next_gap: Expose focus gaps and timing quality beside action-label comparisons.

capabilities.title: Gameplay sampling and teaching sessions
limits: Passive still sampler is bounded to 1–60 seconds and 1–5 samples per second; it is distinct from video recording.

deck_binding.detail: Sampling produces training evidence.

capabilities.next_gap: Unify sample purpose, completion and artifact status across still/video workflows.

capabilities.title: Example-based visual label suggestions
limits: Requires a completed recording; independent check recordings reject suggestions; proposals are not ground truth.

deck_binding.detail: Review-time labels feed packs rather than dispatch game input.

capabilities.next_gap: Present confidence/ambiguity and reviewed-vs-inferred provenance consistently.

capabilities.title: Game-pack authoring and validation
limits: Pack validation and draft replay do not establish live qualification or arbitrary executable extension support.

deck_binding.detail: Packs describe rules/actions; the deck has separately registered application adapters.

evidence.scope: Pack schema, authoring and replay workflow.

capabilities.next_gap: Reconcile pack actions and routine/deck capability descriptions without introducing another runtime registry.

capabilities.title: Named pack action bindings
callable_surfaces: Schema-2 pack named-action validation and replay resolution
limits: Registry is data scoped to a pack, not a global callable method catalog; a replay proposal is not dispatched input.

deck_binding.detail: No automatic promotion from an arbitrary pack action to a live deck adapter.

capabilities.next_gap: Add a documented mapping between supported pack actions, module actions and trusted live adapters.

capabilities.title: Reusable bounded routine modules
limits: Owned callback is trusted application code; imported bundles cannot choose executable callbacks. Admission alone is not an outcome.

deck_binding.detail: Modules share the scheduler/owner rather than establish a second deck engine.

capabilities.next_gap: Qualify concrete navigation/menu/sigil/Idle bindings through the same observation and receipt contracts.

capabilities.title: Offline routine replay
limits: Saved observations and receipts are replayed without desktop input; replay completion is not live gameplay completion.

deck_binding.detail: review.routine is registered for offline saved-session replay.

capabilities.next_gap: Keep replay and live outcome evidence visibly distinct while comparing pack revisions.

capabilities.title: Job-card configuration and conditional deck
callable_surfaces: Job Deck UI; JobDeckService; registered routine catalog
limits: Most W101 cards are preparation-only. Replay is wired; questing is limited to supported conversations, not navigation/combat/farming.

deck_binding.detail: Registry includes future cards with explicit not-connected status; configuration does not enable them.

capabilities.next_gap: Bind one qualified full-visit adapter at a time and show concrete block reasons.

capabilities.title: Shared deck API and MCP transport
callable_surfaces: JobDeckHost request/reply service; documented CLI/MCP deck interface
limits: Preview facts do not update live observations; transport access does not expand available game capabilities.

deck_binding.detail: Calls the same deck service and registered routines.

evidence.scope: Host request and preview boundary tests.

capabilities.next_gap: Expose a consistent read-only capability/status view before broadening executive calls.

capabilities.title: Single scheduler and input ownership
limits: Finite queue (32), timeouts, cancellation and recovery guards; scheduler completion must not replace adapter-specific outcome verification.

deck_binding.detail: Registered deck jobs execute through the existing scheduler.

capabilities.next_gap: Keep every new live adapter on the same control owner; report queue/recovery state consistently.

capabilities.title: Verified input cleanup and recovery
limits: Preview does not clear recovery; restoring controls does not automatically resume interrupted jobs.

deck_binding.detail: Recovery blocks live admissions until cleanup requirements pass.

evidence.scope: Historical live evidence only; inspect scope and build before relying on it.

capabilities.next_gap: Maintain installed-build evidence and test no-gameplay recovery after releases.

capabilities.title: Optional W101 UI-tree observation
limits: Optional reviewed client adapter; positive UI state and fresh target identity required. Reading a node is not a completed interaction.

deck_binding.detail: Supplies facts to supported W101 adapters; no standalone generic play card.

capabilities.next_gap: Extend measured UI-state coverage while keeping unknown/conflict and disconnect evidence explicit.

capabilities.title: Optional W101 loading and transition gate
limits: Client loading is optional and patch-sensitive; not-loading alone does not prove gameplay readiness.

deck_binding.detail: Shared routine gate rather than an unbounded controller.

capabilities.next_gap: Bind positive loading pauses and ready-state checks uniformly across full visits.

capabilities.title: Selected quest conversation and intent parsing
callable_surfaces: Quest card supported conversation mode; W101QuestConversationOperation.Submit
limits: Can prepare/execute bounded selected dialogue; active-objective parsing is not an autonomous route/combat/collection implementation.

deck_binding.detail: w101.questing supports qualified conversation path; other objective needs remain blocked.

capabilities.next_gap: Connect navigation/combat/collection only after their independent adapters and before/after objective checks pass.

capabilities.title: Navigation, menus and sigil primitives
callable_surfaces: NavigationModule, MenuModule, SigilModule; module graph evaluation
limits: Reusable primitives do not supply world routes, obstacle/enemy avoidance or reliable arbitrary-destination travel.

deck_binding.detail: Quest destination parsing does not automatically dispatch a complete navigation card.

capabilities.next_gap: Complete observed route segments with arrival/failure evidence; compose them under the existing owner.

capabilities.title: Native Idle and optional motion maintenance
callable_surfaces: AutoIdleModule; existing standalone home movement/native Idle flows
limits: User takeover, explicit method, context and observed Idle/resume checks remain required; no universal automatic fallback is qualified.

deck_binding.detail: w101.auto-idle is preparation-only in JobDeckRoutines.

capabilities.next_gap: Connect verified between-run Idle/resume as bounded deck transitions.

capabilities.title: Pet Dance teacher and phased player
callable_surfaces: Pet Dance player/teacher UI; bounded live-trial runner
limits: Current preset evidence is context-specific; standalone phases and visit cleanup are distinct from a qualified repeating deck job.

deck_binding.detail: w101.pet.dance has no connected deck visit adapter.

evidence.scope: Preset provenance records specific live geometry; inventory does not requalify it.

capabilities.next_gap: Connect complete start/play/result/native-Idle visit with finite repeat/energy policy.

capabilities.title: Dodge specialist and isolated learning loop
limits: Experimental policy/isolated test results need context and independent-game evidence; a single score or simulation is not a repeatable real-game average.

deck_binding.detail: Dodge experiment paths exist independently of the current W101 deck catalog.

capabilities.next_gap: Unify specialist registration and version comparison without making W101 semantics mandatory.

capabilities.title: Conjuration recognition and memory proposals
callable_surfaces: Conjuration saved-image recognition/replay and collection tooling
limits: Synthetic positive fixtures only; current-client card identity/layout data and a live player are not qualified.

deck_binding.detail: w101.minigame.conjuration is preparation-only.

capabilities.next_gap: Collect representative game-card examples and independent checks before connecting play.

capabilities.title: Outcome-based experiment workbench
limits: Development/check roles, owner status, policy/context pins and complete-game outcomes matter; test code presence is not a passing experiment.

deck_binding.detail: Experiment workbench is not currently a general deck routine adapter.

capabilities.next_gap: Adopt stable experiment identity with distinct immutable attempts and conflicting-result checks.

capabilities.title: Research notes and reviewed knowledge import
callable_surfaces: Game Research workflow; bounded offline W101 knowledge importer
limits: Source claims and suggested tags are context, not fresh game facts; current importer targets a specific reviewed ledger, not every imported dataset.

deck_binding.detail: Knowledge does not grant an executable deck operation.

capabilities.next_gap: Track chronology, contradictions, source changes and dependent pack invalidation.

capabilities.title: Legacy source catalog and integration maps
callable_surfaces: W101 legacy catalog; offline source/map validation tools
limits: 25 supplied archives mapped does not mean 25 integrations completed. Historical status text may lag current source and policy.

deck_binding.detail: Legacy package availability does not register its arbitrary functions into the deck.

evidence.scope: Archive mapping and historical integration gaps.

capabilities.next_gap: Reconcile current adapter truth and extract one bounded useful capability per integration.

capabilities.title: Optional saved game credentials
limits: Credential setup only; no automatic login submission, launcher interaction, reconnect loop or password retrieval API.

deck_binding.detail: Saved credentials do not authorize or implement a login card.

evidence.scope: Synthetic vault-interface tests; no real credential access.

capabilities.next_gap: Qualify a separately enabled bounded login workflow without recording secrets.

capabilities.title: Bounded combat turn/battle adapter and policies
limits: Source adapters and tests exist; current mechanics, calibrated targets, full battles and quest collection outcomes require evidence.

deck_binding.detail: w101.battle remains preparation-only; Quest card does not yet dispatch combat objectives.

capabilities.next_gap: Verify fresh hand/target observations, bounded input and outcomes before connecting the Quest/Battle cards.
